name: T1
title: Air connectivity and the pollution and carbon intensity of the economy, 1996--2023
rows: __PANEL__Panel A: OLS, country and year FE
__PANEL__Panel B: 2SLS, ln GACI instrumented by air market access
note: Unified sample: 176 countries, 1996--2023, country-years with ln GACI, the controls, SO2, NOx, CO2 and energy intensities and the instrument observed (renewable shares are reported where available: WDI to 2021, electricity share to 2023). SO2 and NOx from CEDS v\_2025\_03\_18. All denominators from one source (WDI GDP in constant 2015 US\$ = GDP per capita $\times$ population), so log identities hold exactly. Country and year fixed effects; controls ln population, ln GDP per capita and its square. Standard errors clustered by country. *, **, *** : 10, 5, 1\%. Within-country SD of ln GACI = 0.076. Because ln GDP per capita is a regressor, the ln GACI coefficient is identical for the per-GDP and per-capita versions of each outcome (ln X/GDP = ln X/pop $-$ ln GDP/pop). Panel B instruments ln GACI with Feyrer-type air market access (country geography $\times$ world air-traffic growth); first-stage F is the cluster-robust F on the excluded instrument.

name: T1b
title: Identity decompositions: ln SO2/GDP = ln E/GDP + ln CO2/E + ln SO2/CO2, and Kaya
note: Unified sample: 176 countries, 1996--2023, country-years with ln GACI, the controls, SO2, NOx, CO2 and energy intensities and the instrument observed (renewable shares are reported where available: WDI to 2021, electricity share to 2023). SO2 and NOx from CEDS v\_2025\_03\_18. All denominators from one source (WDI GDP in constant 2015 US\$ = GDP per capita $\times$ population), so log identities hold exactly. Country and year fixed effects; controls ln population, ln GDP per capita and its square. Standard errors clustered by country. *, **, *** : 10, 5, 1\%. Columns 2--4 decompose column 1 exactly (energy intensity, carbon intensity of energy, sulphur intensity of carbon); column 6 decomposes NOx/GDP as cols 2+3+6. Kaya: ln CO2 = ln pop + ln GDP/pop + ln E/GDP + ln CO2/E; with ln pop and ln GDP/pop as controls the ln GACI coefficient on ln CO2 (col 7) equals the sum of cols 2 and 3. Panel B instruments ln GACI with Feyrer-type air market access (country geography $\times$ world air-traffic growth); first-stage F is the cluster-robust F on the excluded instrument.

name: T2
title: Technique, not scale: SO2 per unit of fuel burned
rows: __PANEL__Panel A: OLS, country and year FE
note: Unified sample: 176 countries, 1996--2023, country-years with ln GACI, the controls, SO2, NOx, CO2 and energy intensities and the instrument observed (renewable shares are reported where available: WDI to 2021, electricity share to 2023). SO2 and NOx from CEDS v\_2025\_03\_18. All denominators from one source (WDI GDP in constant 2015 US\$ = GDP per capita $\times$ population), so log identities hold exactly. Country and year fixed effects; controls ln population, ln GDP per capita and its square. Standard errors clustered by country. *, **, *** : 10, 5, 1\%. SO2 per unit of fuel use: CEDS SO2 from coal (oil) divided by Energy Institute coal (oil) consumption in TWh (77 countries). SO2 per fuel CO2: CEDS SO2 from a fuel divided by OWID CO2 from the same fuel (all countries). Process SO2 = smelting and refining. Panel B instruments ln GACI with Feyrer-type air market access (country geography $\times$ world air-traffic growth); first-stage F is the cluster-robust F on the excluded instrument.

note: Unified sample: 176 countries, 1996--2023, country-years with ln GACI, the controls, SO2, NOx, CO2 and energy intensities and the instrument observed (renewable shares are reported where available: WDI to 2021, electricity share to 2023). name: T5
title: Instrumental-variable diagnostics
cols: ln SO2/GDP: IV: unweighted GACI mean (ME)
ln NOx/GDP: IV: unweighted GACI mean (ME)
Renewable share (pp): IV: unweighted GACI mean (ME)

note: Unified sample: 176 countries, 1996--2023, country-years with ln GACI, the controls, SO2, NOx, CO2 and energy intensities and the instrument observed (renewable shares are reported where available: WDI to 2021, electricity share to 2023). SO2 and NOx from CEDS v\_2025\_03\_18. All denominators from one source (WDI GDP in constant 2015 US\$ = GDP per capita $\times$ population), so log identities hold exactly. Country and year fixed effects; controls ln population, ln GDP per capita and its square. Standard errors clustered by country. *, **, *** : 10, 5, 1\%. Reduced form regresses the outcome directly on the instrument. The measurement-error IV instruments the seat-weighted ln GACI with the unweighted country mean of airport GACI: a classical-measurement-error correction that uses no exclusion restriction beyond independent measurement error; if the OLS coefficient is attenuated, this estimate should exceed OLS. Sargan J from the over-identified model.
